C:\CATALOGU.HTM

1,831 games

The catalogue

Every game on the 8bitchip.info website's list of hard-disk adaptations (fromhd3.php), with how its adaptation reaches its files and its verdict from Hatari's GEMDOS drive. A game runs on every machine, and from the SidecarTridge Multidevice's GEMDRIVE too, unless its row says otherwise. A game's name opens its page on the 8bitchip.info website, where its download is. The floppy use, and the machines a game does not run on, come from that page. The picture is the last screen of the game's run, on an ST with TOS 1.04 (STE games: TOS 1.62). For a fixed game, it is the last screen of its fixed run.

SPY2.ZIP: SPY2.PRG gives back the memory its stack is in (Mshrink) and starts SPY2.BOY; Hatari's Pexec clears the new program's free memory (no fastload bit), the caller's stack with it, and TOS reads the Pexec as Pterm0 (trials/spy2/runs/20261013-112912-st-104-gemdrive-spy2-usp); with SPY2.BOY's fastload bit set it plays its demo (trials/spy2/runs/20261013-112748-st-104-gemdrive-spy2-fastload) On the list: not on Falcon S3: the fastload bit in the program it starts (set by tools/set_fastload.py).
